allocation_note: Separate local subdivision funded from existing pool headroom. Existing peer grant and its outstanding source allowance remain reserved in full; none is reclaimed or double-spent. No compiler artifact or package installation. Root owns this implementation and any later run; peer instructed to retain prior evidence and review only on resuming.
policy: For each independent arm starting with zero shares, submit native P to Lido and define sale quantity as actual post-submit displayed balance B. Use post-submit Curve get_dy(1,0,P)+1 wei as conditional optimistic payout bound only if B<=P and all domain/source/state checks pass. No exchange or transaction submission.

state_model.state_overrides: Only synthetic sender native funding11ETH and nonce0. No contract code/storage, shares, token balance or allowance override. Empty-code sender/fee recipient fixed and distinct from each other and all contracts.
state_model.child_time: Fixed parent timestamp+12s; at initial header decision receipt require modeled time>=decision UTC+400ms, otherwise unavailable without replacement. Before economic calls require monotonic decision+400ms. All arms independently reset to same numeric parent/time. Requests may finish after modeled child; no obtainable inclusion claim.
state_model.block_overrides: Fixed gasLimit30000000, baseFeePerGas1000000000, empty-code feeRecipient, withdrawals[]. No unrelated transactions. Exact keys/payloads must be reviewed and frozen before RPC.
state_model.transactions: Gas1000000 per call, sequential nonce, maxFeePerGas2000000000,maxPriorityFeePerGas1000000000; metadata checks9calls, economic arms5calls each. Synthetic gas is not measured composed-route cost.

domain_checks: Require I=totalShares-externalShares>0, E=totalPooledEther-externalEther>0, externalShares<totalShares; P<2^128-1; buffer+P<2^128; totalShares+floor(P*I/E)<2^128; unpaused/within child stake limit; initial shares0; returned minted shares equal floor(P*I/E), displayed B equals predicted amount and B<=P; fee between0 and10^10; exact ABI, status, gas, child headers and unchanged final parent. Uncertainty is unavailable, never negative.
decision_rule: All four valid U<=P may park this fixed route/sample before further nonnegative costs. U>P is only failure to reject, not profit. Any unavailable arm prevents all-arm negative conclusion. Source/runtime provenance conditional, numeric parent can reorg out and back undetected, no gas/exchange/flatness/inclusion validation.
exclusions: No new event/pool, price-driven size changes, RPC retry or endpoint fallback, account credentials, real wallet/balances, approvals, dust transfers, execution/deployment, compiler/install or reserved research raw. Prior peer v1/v2 artifacts remain immutable.
run_gate: Root full source/tests/exact19request manifest review and frozen plan commit required before one explicit --run --plan-sha256 command. This draft permits only offline implementation.
